**Algorithm 1. Pathwise concomitant Huber CD with an interchangeable scale block.**
Blue expressions mark additions or replacements relative to Algorithm 1 of
@kim2025exact.

$$
\begin{aligned}
\psi_\tau(z)&=\operatorname{sign}(z)\min\{\lvert z\rvert,\tau\},\\
V_j(\beta,g,\lambda)&=
\begin{cases}
\lvert g_j+\lambda\operatorname{sign}(\beta_j)\rvert,&\beta_j\ne0,\\
(\lvert g_j\rvert-\lambda)_+,&\beta_j=0,
\end{cases}\\
R_\beta(\beta,r,\sigma,\lambda)&=
\max_{1\le j\le p}V_j\!\left(\beta,-n^{-1}X^\top\psi_\rho(r/\sigma),\lambda\right),\\
R_\sigma(r,\sigma)&=
\left\lvert a-\frac1{2n}\sum_{i=1}^n\psi_\rho(r_i/\sigma)^2\right\rvert .
\end{aligned}
$$

| Line | Instruction |
|--:|:--|
| 1 | **Input:** $X\in\mathbb R^{n\times p},\ y\in\mathbb R^n,\ \lambda_1\ge\cdots\ge\lambda_L>0$; [$\rho,a,\sigma^{(0)},\epsilon,\epsilon_\sigma,\gamma>0,\ B,K,T\in\mathbb N_+,\ \mathcal U\in\{\mathrm{MM},\mathrm{Root},\mathrm{Prox}\}$.]{.addition} |
| 2 | $\widehat\beta_0\leftarrow0$; [$\widehat\sigma_0\leftarrow\sigma^{(0)}$.]{.addition} |
| 3 | **For** $\ell=1,\ldots,L$ **do** |
| 4 | $\beta\leftarrow\widehat\beta_{\ell-1},\ r\leftarrow y-X\beta$; [$\sigma\leftarrow\widehat\sigma_{\ell-1}$.]{.addition} |
| 5 | [**For** $k=1,\ldots,K$ **do**]{.addition} |
| 6 | [$M\leftarrow\|r\|_\infty$.]{.addition} |
| 7 | [**If** $M=0$: **return** $\big((\widehat\beta_m,\widehat\sigma_m,\kappa_m)_{m<\ell},(\beta,0,0)\big)$.]{.addition} |
| 8 | [$q\leftarrow r/M,\ t\leftarrow\sigma/M,\ m\leftarrow\#\{i:q_i\ne0\}$; **if** $2na\ge m\rho^2$: **return** the zero-scale candidate.]{.addition} |
| 9 | [$(t,b,\nu)\leftarrow\mathrm{Scale}_{\mathcal U}(q,t;B,T,\epsilon_\sigma,\gamma)$; $\sigma\leftarrow Mt$.]{.addition} |
| 10 | [$\delta\leftarrow\rho\sigma,\quad\eta\leftarrow\sigma\lambda_\ell$.]{.addition} |
| 11 | [$E\leftarrow\{j:\beta_j\ne0\}\cup\{j:\lvert X_j^\top\psi_\delta(r)/n\rvert>\eta\}$.]{.addition} |
| 12 | **For** $j\in E$ $(j\uparrow)$ **do** |
| 13 | $u\leftarrow r+X_j\beta_j,\quad \beta_j^{-}\leftarrow\beta_j$. |
| 14 | $\beta_j\leftarrow\operatorname{ExactHuberCoordinate}(u,X_j,\delta,\eta)$. |
| 15 | $r\leftarrow r-X_j(\beta_j-\beta_j^{-})$. |
| 16 | **End for** |
| 17 | [$v_\beta\leftarrow R_\beta(\beta,r,\sigma,\lambda_\ell),\quad v_\sigma\leftarrow R_\sigma(r,\sigma)$.]{.addition} |
| 18 | [**If** $\max(v_\beta,v_\sigma)\le\epsilon$: **break**; **end for**.]{.addition} |
| 19 | $\widehat\beta_\ell\leftarrow\beta$; [$\widehat\sigma_\ell\leftarrow\sigma,\quad\kappa_\ell\leftarrow\mathbf1_{\{\max(v_\beta,v_\sigma)\le\epsilon\}}$.]{.addition} |
| 20 | [**If** $\kappa_\ell=0$: **return** $(\widehat\beta_m,\widehat\sigma_m,\kappa_m)_{m=1}^{\ell}$.]{.addition} |
| 21 | **End for**; **return** $(\widehat\beta_\ell,$ [$\widehat\sigma_\ell,\kappa_\ell$]{.addition}$)_{\ell=1}^{L}$. |

$$
B=8,\qquad
\kappa_\ell=1\ \Longleftrightarrow\
\sigma>0,\ \max(v_\beta,v_\sigma)\le\epsilon .
$$

**Algorithm 2.** $\operatorname{ExactHuberCoordinate}(u,x,\delta,\eta)$.

$$
\begin{aligned}
h_\delta(z)&=
\begin{cases}
z^2/2,&\lvert z\rvert\le\delta,\\
\delta\lvert z\rvert-\delta^2/2,&\lvert z\rvert>\delta,
\end{cases}\\
\operatorname{ExactHuberCoordinate}(u,x,\delta,\eta)
&\in\underset{\theta\in\mathbb R}{\arg\min}
\left\{\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^n h_\delta(u_i-x_i\theta)+\eta\lvert\theta\rvert\right\}.
\end{aligned}
$$

| Line | Instruction |
|--:|:--|
| 1 | **Input:** $u,x\in\mathbb R^n,\ \delta,\eta>0$. |
| 2 | $g_0\leftarrow-n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i\operatorname{sign}(u_i)\min\{\lvert u_i\rvert,\delta\}$. |
| 3 | **If** $\lvert g_0\rvert\le\eta$: **return** $0$. |
| 4 | $d\leftarrow-\operatorname{sign}(g_0),\quad D\leftarrow dg_0+\eta,\quad c\leftarrow0,\quad I\leftarrow\{i:x_i\ne0\}$. |
| 5 | **For** $i\in I$ **do** |
| 6 | [$M\leftarrow\|r\|_\infty$.]{.addition} |
| 7 | [**If** $M=0$: **return** $\big((\widehat\beta_m,\widehat\sigma_m,\kappa_m)_{m<\ell},(\beta,0,0)\big)$.]{.addition} |
| 8 | [$q\leftarrow r/M,\ t\leftarrow\sigma/M,\ m\leftarrow\#\{i:q_i\ne0\}$; **if** $2na\ge m\rho^2$: **return** the zero-scale candidate.]{.addition} |
| 9 | [$(t,b,\nu)\leftarrow\mathrm{Scale}_{\mathcal U}(q,t;B,T,\epsilon_\sigma,\gamma)$; $\sigma\leftarrow Mt$.]{.addition} |
| 10 | [$\delta\leftarrow\rho\sigma,\quad\eta\leftarrow\sigma\lambda_\ell$.]{.addition} |
| 11 | $J_m\leftarrow\sum_{i\in I}w_i\big(\mathbf1_{\{a_i=v_m\}}-\mathbf1_{\{b_i=v_m\}}\big)$. |
| 12 | **If** $S>0$ **and** $D+S(v_m-c)\ge0$: **return** $d(c-D/S)$. |
| 13 | $D\leftarrow D+S(v_m-c),\quad c\leftarrow v_m,\quad S\leftarrow S+J_m$. |
| 14 | **End for**; **return** $dc$. |


**Optional subroutine: SafeguardedSupportStep.** On the current nonzero support
(and unpenalized intercept), form the gradient and Hessian of the original
perspective objective. Solve the ridged Newton system and accept a positive-scale
step only after the Armijo test stated in the text. Otherwise retain the CD/MM
iterate. The PDF gives its mathematical pseudocode.
